used_by: frontend/frontend-react/src/utils/nominatim.js (Dashboard search and region pick, in the browser; the backend does not call Nominatim)

facts.quote: an absolute maximum of 1 request per second
facts.applied: one request at a time, at least MIN_INTERVAL_MS = 1000 ms apart

facts.quote: Provide a valid HTTP Referer or User-Agent identifying the application
facts.applied: browser requests send the Referer (page origin; referrerPolicy strict-origin-when-cross-origin). A browser cannot set User-Agent.

facts.quote: Clearly display attribution as suitable for your medium.
facts.applied: NominatimCredit ('© OpenStreetMap contributors', ODbL) next to the searched place on the Dashboard

facts.quote: Results must be cached on your side.
facts.applied: per-query cache in memory and sessionStorage; identical queries in flight share one request

facts.quote: you must not implement such a service on the client side using the API
facts.applied: search runs only on Find / Enter / region pick; typing sends nothing; a queued search overtaken by a newer one is dropped before it is sent
